upsert.meaning: 100k existing VIDs with identical text, graph acknowledgements only, not index visibility or sustained changed/new writes

rebuild.meaning: CREATE-triggered auto backfill plus explicit REBUILD and metadata/2-second polling; not isolated engine build speed or exact first-query-visible time

must_keep_qualifications: 112.88x is equal-mix four-query MATCH on/off in the same cluster, not ES and not every individual query speedup.
Input is a real contiguous 1m prefix projected to 128 Unicode chars; 99.308% cropped; not 100m execution/full documents/random representative sample.
On/off total samples 800/80, each query 200/20, warmup 3/1; off pooled P99 is max, on pooled P99 rank 792.
Single sequential on/off/restore trial with no cache reset/randomization/repeats/confidence interval; off retains the fulltext index and its resources.

QPS is successes divided by wall time, latency is client roundtrip, four-query pooled percentiles; LIMIT 10 output not unlimited result retrieval. Full no-LIMIT oracle validates semantic equality separately.
Dynamic c4 36.631 QPS is 800 requests/21.839s with near-four average inflight, not saturation/max throughput. Old fixed-worker 16.268 is a different scheduling experiment.
100k 21184 rows/s is 4.72s same-ID/same-text rewrite acknowledgement; matching results afterwards cannot prove event application or visibility latency.
66.15s is observed CREATE/REBUILD completion with three storage tasks, overlapping/possibly repeated auto builds and polling; later visibility checked separately.
Resource values are five-service sampled maxima from unmatched windows, not full-machine peak/cost or demonstrated machine/memory downsize.

Million figures precede subsequent TopK rebuild/restart; do not attribute these MATCH numbers to TopK, mix binary evidence with 10k, or compare them directly with different TEXT_SEARCH/ES_QUERY semantics.
